question: What constant places each epoch's surface on surveyed NAVD88 at this site, using ONLY that epoch's own contemporaneous control?

inputs.role: gen1's OWN 2008 MnGeo/MnDNR validation control; the column dnr_error_m is Control Z - Surface Z, verified exact on 1004 of 1004 rows
gen2's OWN 2021 USGS NVA/VVA held-out checkpoints; the usgs_*_error_m columns are Z - <surface>z, verified exact on all four columns

params.name: epoch_matching
params.why: Andy's directive: adjust each epoch internally, no cross-epoch control

params.name: gen2_surfaces
params.why: gen2 publishes FOUR surfaces and they are four different answers; these are reported side by side, not reduced to one

params.name: max_lags_m
params.why: swept, not fitted once: the control does not determine a variogram range and single fits pin to the largest lag centre

params.name: n_lags
params.why: lag bins in the empirical variogram; excludes nothing -- it sets the resolution at which the sweep can see structure, not which marks enter

params.name: n_pairs
params.why: random pairs drawn per variogram; excludes no marks, but a small value would add sampling noise to the fit and so to sd_field

params.name: estimators
params.why: dowd is robust, matheron is classical; both are run so the nugget/sill partition's instability is visible

params.name: seed
params.why: fixes the random pair draw so the run is reproducible; changing it re-draws pairs and moves the fit slightly, not the marks

params.name: cover_treatment
params.why: the largest single lever in the problem; choosing one here would silently set the datum

params.name: bridge_mm
params.why: delivered-surface -> our reconstructed surface; None means NOT applied and NOT assumed zero

columns.epoch: which acquisition the constant is for
columns.selection: gen2 surface (if any) and cover treatment
columns.n_marks: control marks entering the kriging system
columns.constant_mm: constant to ADD to the DELIVERED surface at the site, mm; median over the variogram sweep; positive = surface reads LOW
columns.sweep_min_mm: smallest constant over the variogram sweep, mm
columns.sweep_max_mm: largest constant over the variogram sweep, mm
columns.sd_field_mm: sd of the error in predicting the spatially correlated component of the surface offset at this coordinate, mm; median over the sweep; NOT an SE of a mean over marks
columns.sd_field_min_mm: smallest sd_field over the sweep, mm
columns.sd_field_max_mm: largest sd_field over the sweep, mm

notes: gen1 reads ONLY the 2008 table and gen2 ONLY the 2021 table. No cross-epoch control is read and no flight-line chaining is performed.
sd_field is set by the fitted nugget/sill partition, which short-lag pairs do not identify on a control set spread over ~200 km; its sweep range is reported for that reason.
headline: gen1 open -12.99 mm; gen2 ql1_laz open -6.56 mm; gen2 ql0_laz open +5.28 mm
